answer: Your records list no allergies. There are no allergy entries from any of the three hospital record pulls (2024, 2025 and October 2026). That is not proof you have none: it may mean nobody recorded any, or that allergies were never asked about or never sent over. If you know of a reaction to a medicine, food or anything else, tell your care team so it can be added.
